title: Dragon Ball Super Returns After 8 Years With Epic New Anime Opening – Watch Now
content: Dragon Ball Super has made its official return with a newly enhanced anime series , and with it has kicked off its grand comeback with epic new opening and ending theme sequences.
author: ComicBook

title: The Apothecary Diaries Highlights Maomao x Jinshi With New Movie Trailer – Watch
content: The Apothecary Diaries is gearing up to hit the big screen with its debut feature film effort, and a new trailer is teasing fans with some of its big Maomao and Jinshi moments. The anime adaptation for Natsu Hyuga’s original novel series has made its return for its third season as part of the ongoing Fall 2026 anime…

title: New Godzilla Minus Zero Trailer Teases Massive New Enemy – Watch Now
content: Godzilla Minus Zero is now only a month away from its worldwide takeover across theaters , and now fans have gotten the best look at what to expect yet with a final trailer helping to show all of it off. Godzilla Minus One kicked off a whole new era for Toho and the legendary kaiju franchise.
author: ComicBook

title: Godzilla Minus Zero Film Streams Final Trailer
content: TOHO began streaming the final trailer for Godzilla Minus Zero , the new Godzilla film from Godzilla Minus One 's Takashi Yamazaki , on Sunday. Min Tanaka ( 47 Ronin , live-action Rurouni Kenshin films) plays biologist Kanji Murakami.
author: ANN

title: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady's Treasure Releases Maomao and Jinshi Character Trailer
content: The Apothecary Diaries: The Late Lady’s Treasure has released a new character trailer for Maomao and Jinshi ahead of the film’s December 11, 2026 premiere in Japan. The video is the first in a four-day series of character promotional videos (PVs) being released for the upcoming movie.
author: Anime Corner

title: 'Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi' Reveals Main Cast, 2027 Debut
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Enma Akiyama 's Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi ( Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend ) manga revealed the main cast and a key visual (pictured) on Sunday. The anime series will premiere in 2027.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend TV Anime Unveils Main Cast, 2027 Debut
content: Kadokawa unveiled the first key visual, main cast members, and the 2027 premiere for the television anime of Enma Akiyama 's Noa Is My Senior, and My Friend. ( Noa-senpai wa Tomodachi. ) manga on Sunday.
author: ANN

title: i☆Ris Voice Actress Idol Unit to Disband at End of 2027
content: The official website for the i☆Ris voice actress idol unit announced on Sunday that the group will end its activities at the end of 2027, which also marks the group's 15th anniversary.
author: ANN

title: Yasuki Tanaka's Ghost Fixers Manga Ends in Next Chapter
content: Tanaka launched the manga on Shonen Jump+ in March 2024. Shueisha published the manga's seventh compiled volume on March 4. MANGA Plus is publishing the manga in English, and it describes the story: Following a certain event, Mikurigaoka New Town transformed into a crucible of supernatural phenomena known as GHOSTS!
author: ANN

title: Boichi's The Marshal King Manga Ends on October 16
content: Boichi 's The Marshal King manga revealed in its 33rd chapter on Friday that it will end in the next chapter on October 16. The manga went on hiatus in December and resumed on September 4.
author: ANN
